title: 14. Extend an account with a fee rule

examples.explanation: Standard: 10 + 2 = 12 leaves 8. Then 8 + 2 = 10 is more than 8, so it is rejected.
Premium: 10 is at the threshold, so there is no fee and 10 remains. Then 8 + 2 = 10 leaves 0.

hints: Let the base withdrawal method call a fee method.
Initialize base fields with super(), then store the premium threshold.
